notes: Fixes three things from 0.3.41. Print label and Print a test label failed with a missing System.Drawing.Printing message: the print script now loads its printing pieces the way Windows PowerShell expects. Address Verify on the Ship page called every address unverified: the check was being sent to EasyPost in the wrong spot, so EasyPost never ran it. Deleting an order the cloud had already removed said order not found: that ghost row now just leaves your list.
